beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: S*LM asks which parts of an agent's work actually require a general language model.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The star includes small, specialized, and symbolic components, without treating them as interchangeable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its supplier example separates understanding a restriction from calculating exposure and authorizing communication.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks how much generality each role actually needs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers can evaluate a research programme about allocation, rather than another promise of universal replacement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A request asks for affected suppliers and exposure, while explicitly forbidding outgoing messages.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Interpreting the restriction requires resolving ambiguity and retrieving the authoritative policy version.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A tested calculation uses structured supplier records instead of inventing arithmetic in prose.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The drafting component receives approved results but no authority to send them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers can follow each obligation into the contracts governing different components.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Repeated work may justify a compact policy, deterministic procedure, or specialized model.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That possibility depends on maintenance, changing tasks, verification, and end-to-end performance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A cheaper component is not a saving if the surrounding workflow becomes unreliable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book states hypotheses and conditions that could weaken its proposed approach.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It keeps access to general models and human judgment where narrower components remain insufficient.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the taxonomy separating size, specialization, and symbolic structure.
